source.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
source.title: Iran-related Designations; Belarus and North Korea Designations Removals; Issuance of Iran-related and Russia-related General Licenses and Amended Frequently Asked Questions

summary: OFAC announced Iran-related sanctions designations on 21 October 2026 under the press title 'Operation Economic Outcast Targets Iran's Shadow Fleet Networks,' adding five Panamanian individuals (three sharing the surname Karnakis Kosmas, two sharing Ortega Jones), the Panama/Greece-registered entity Karnakis and Karnakis, a Singapore entity (Amigoz Singapore Pte. Ltd.), a UAE shipping line (Whales Shipping Line LLC), a Panama-flagged vessel owner (Roxette Maritime Shipping and Trading S.A.) and nine vessels, all designated under IRAN-EO13902 and linked to one another through shared ownership, addresses and corporate structures consistent with shadow-fleet operations. The same action issued Iran General Licenses GG and HH, Russia-related General License 131K concerning the sale of Lukoil International GmbH, and amended FAQs 1224 and 1225. It also recorded the deletion from the SDN List of several North Korea-linked (DPRK3) Chinese animation-studio entities and an individual (Lu, Hezheng) tied to SEK Studio, and listed three name variants for one Belarus-designated individual (Andrei Rybakou/Rybakov). No scheme mechanics are described for the Belarus or North Korea entries; they are administrative delisting/listing notices only.

extraction_notes: 1) knowledge_centre_resolve_actor returned 'Unresolved' (not in register) for every actor extracted -- Ioanis, Konstantinos and Sofianos Karnakis Kosmas, Pedro and Roberto Ortega Jones, Amigoz Singapore Pte. Ltd., Karnakis and Karnakis, Roxette Maritime Shipping and Trading S.A., Whales Shipping Line LLC, and all nine vessels (Anemos, Destiny, Flamingo 1, Gloris, Harmony, Pride, Prince, Whales Diamond, Whales Pearl) -- so none carry a prior actor_id; all are new to the governed register. 2) SAN004 (Front Companies) was considered for Karnakis and Karnakis / Roxette / Whales Shipping Line but not recorded: the document gives corporate registration data, not the no-substance indicators (no employees, no premises, dormancy) the doctrine requires, so the link would be speculative. A human reviewer may wish to add it if corroborating open-source data on these entities exists. 3) The Belarus (Rybakov/Rybakou, Andrei) and North Korea/DPRK3 (Moxing Cartoon, Shanghai Moxing, Lu Hezheng, Shanghai Hongman) entries are pure list changes (three name-variant listings for one Belarus individual; deletions for the DPRK3 group) with no scheme narrative, so no typology or actor records were created for them -- flagged here only for completeness of the SDN List changes this advisory reports. 4) General Licenses GG, HH and 131K and FAQs 1224/1225 are administrative/licensing actions, not typology evidence, and are noted in the summary only.
